FOUR genuine engine-viewport headings exactly as reference: N top-left front UP, NE top-right front UPPER RIGHT, E bottom-left front RIGHT horizontal, SE bottom-right front LOWER RIGHT. Dish yaw is relative to each actual craft heading; do not mirror or rotate flat pictures. Fixed elevated orthographic camera, fixed upper-left screen light.
Crisp classic1990s Tycoon pixel-art clusters, restrained matte cream bus/dark-teal cup/cyan rim/navy paddles/amber hatch, tiny28x24px native craft, no smooth3D or photorealism.
SAFE BORDERED1536x1024 transparent sheet,6px opaque PURE MAGENTA frames N(24,24)-(744,488),NE(792,24)-(1512,488),E(24,536)-(744,1000),SE(792,536)-(1512,1000).
